title: Your SaaS Bill Is Ridiculous
objective: Create a short, substantially original English ABVX Books publication based on first-party repository and documentation research, using the supplied Russian PDF only as a lead corpus and rights-constrained research source.

canonical_manuscript.notes: Manuscript v2 reframes the work as a curated discovery booklet / field guide rather than a conventional small book. The source PDF remains research-leads-only and is not approved for verbatim translation or republication.

format_artifacts.notes: Four-page booklet proof with no internal title page, no chapter ceremony, refined fact-block alignment, clickable URL styling, and clean PDF text layer.

Publication-ready discovery booklet with canonical-link corrections, booklet-format structure, validated text extraction and final ABVX Books publication. Published on 2026-08-12 via https://abvx.xyz/books/your-saas-bill-is-ridiculous with direct PDF at https://abvx.xyz/media/books/your-saas-bill-is-ridiculous/your-saas-bill-is-ridiculous.pdf.

qa_boundary: human final booklet review before ABVXsite publication
edition_states.next_action: Acceptance case complete. Any retrospective, renderer cleanup or future format expansion is a separate scoped mission.

human_gates.rule: Final shortlist, compact TOC, source-use boundary and publication shape were approved for compact manuscript production.
Manuscript v1 passed human editorial review for design with light editorial cleanup only. Broad rewriting remains out of scope.
ABVX Books publication packet, downloadable artifact, metadata and public positioning were approved and released publicly.

Several repository replacement claims in the source PDF are stale, partial or materially overstated.
Retrospective cleanup for the Book Factory publication path remains a separate mission.
